If you’re currently working on an MBA strategic report, you’ve likely felt that nagging doubt: 'Is this analytical enough?' 

Most students fall into the 54% Trap: filling pages with generic SWOT tables and surface-level observations. It’s safe, it’s readable, but it never pushes past a mid-tier grade because it lacks a cohesive 'so what?' factor.

To hit that 78% Blueprint, you need to pivot from description to synthesis:

• The 54% Trap: Listing bullet points in a SWOT table without cross-analyzing internal capabilities against external threats, and giving vague non-budgeted advice.

• The 1st Class Blueprint: Integrating VRIO core competencies with PESTLE macro-risks, supported by financial ratio analysis (ROIC, EBITDA) and a budgeted implementation roadmap.
